method: The code implements an ensemble model for the Spooky Author Identification task. **Data preprocessing** includes text feature engineering (word/char counts, punctuation ratios, author-specific keyword scoring for Lovecraft/Poe/Shelley) combined with TF-IDF word (1-3 grams) and character (2-5 grams) features, all scaled and stacked into a sparse matrix. **Model architecture** is a three-component ensemble: (1) DeBERTa-v3-large transformer with sequence classification head, (2) a CharCNN with multi-kernel 1D convolutions on character embeddings, and (3) an XGBoost classifier trained on extracted features. Learnable weights blend the three component predictions. **Training** uses a stratified 85/15 split, AdamW optimizer with cosine annealing warm restarts, mixed precision, early stopping (patience=5), label smoothing, and up to 30 epochs. The final submission blends Deep learning and XGBoost predictions using the learned weights.
